subject: general
question: The National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993, was repealed by The National Commission for Backward Classes (Repeal) Act in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__2018__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central Govt has **repealed **"The National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993" **with effect from 15.8.2018.**
 
• National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) was initially constituted by the Central Government by "The National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993" dated 2.4.1993.
 
• So far the Commission had been reconstituted 7 times up to 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Present Commission (8th) has been accorded Constitutional Status through “The Constitution (One Hundred and Second Amendment) Act, 2018” Act dated 11.8.2018.
 
• Article 338B has been inserted, forming a Commission for the socially and educationally backward classes to be known as NCBC.
 
• The Commission consists of a Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, and three other Members in the rank & pay of Secretary to the Government of India.
 
• **Chairman - Shri Hansraj Gangaram Ahir** and the 3 Members Shri Achary Thalloju, Dr. Sudha Yadav, Shri Kaushlendra Singh Patel. For more:- link
 
• **Vice-Chairman**- Dr. Lokesh Kumar Prajapati
 
• **Secretary**-Shri Rajeev Ranjan. 
 
• **Headquarters - **New Delhi
